final_text: The bug was that `load` was gated behind `en`, and shift-right used a constant `0` fill instead of `sin`. I fixed both: `load` now takes priority independent of `en`, and shift-right shifts in `sin`. All tests pass (`TEST PASSED`), so the design now meets the spec.
